capabilities.notes: On Windows agy 1.4.2, strict validation warns that a plugin-root GEMINI.md is never loaded; staging in config/GEMINI.md passed for both profiles. Registration still replaces only the marked block in the native global GEMINI.md and preserves operator-owned sections. Historical agy 1.2.12 headless evidence established global-file loading, not runtime verification of this new package. The canonical rules remain in their separate global rule file.

Google's Rules page lists ~/.gemini/config/rules/*.md as global rules, truncates one rule file at 24,000 bytes, and gives all active global and always_on rules a 20,000-token budget. On agy 1.2.12 a rule file without a trigger was rejected (rules.go: Invalid rule trigger); with trigger: always_on a headless session quoted its first and last line while it also quoted the last line of a 23,678-character GEMINI.md, so the byte limit applies per file.

agy plugin validate reported '28 processed' for this layout, and a headless agy session named three real skill folders while running from a directory with no .agents folder, so the global install is active on its own.

Native validation/discovery was observed historically; current App/CLI docs support model inheritance and commandExecutionPolicy. Template declares inherit/eager; effective autonomy and standalone IDE behavior still require native verification.

install accepts a plain local directory; unlike codex plugin add it does not clone the source with git. The installed copy does not follow later renders, so re-running install is required after every package update.
Read from agy plugin --help on 1.2.7. plugin validate reports the processed count for skills, agents, commands, mcpServers, and hooks; a rules folder is not a processed component.
Pointing agy plugin validate at a package whose manifest sits in .claude-plugin/ fails with 'missing plugin.json', so the manifest must be at the root.

Managed launch discovers agy models before each CLI session. Windows catalog on 2026-10-19 selected gemini-4-argon-high/high. Syntax accepts xhigh/max but only available model variants establish effort support. App/standalone IDE automatic selection is unconfirmed.
agy --help documents --effort low|medium|high. No higher level is documented.

Current Google hooks contract documents SessionStart for App, CLI and IDE. PreCompact is not established. Inlined routing remains the only bootstrap carrier; no duplicate hook is rendered. Native execution is not verified by documentation.
Current CLI documents /statusline. No custom statusline is rendered, and App/IDE UI support is not inferred.

Google's plugin documentation (checked 2026-09-27) says Antigravity Desktop and Antigravity IDE, two separate apps, both read the global plugin root and a workspace .agents/plugins/ folder; the IDE's built-in agy-customizations guide names the global root ~/.gemini/config/. agy plugin install fills the global slot; without agy the copy is manual. The versions are the last installed ones seen (Desktop on Windows 2026-08-31, IDE on macOS 2026-09-27). Neither app has a headless mode: loading is NOT_RUN_UNAVAILABLE until someone checks its Customizations view.
